lyrics:
[Intro: soft swelling chords, scattered vocal chops]
(One, one in)

[Beat Enters: broken garage-style drums, deep sub bass]
(Last, la-, one in)

[Section A: chords swell wide, chops answer the snare]
(One in, one in)

[Break: drums out, chords held, bare feet on wet tiles]

[Spoken: several voices, whispering, then one shout]
One, two
Last one in!

[Drop: full beat, widest chords, a big splash]
(Last, la-, one in)
(One in, one in)

[Outro: chords alone, water settling, quiet laughing]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 130 BPM, 4/4 with a broken garage rhythm, A major. Rushing, emotional and joyful.

VOICE: No sung verses. Short chopped fragments of a woman's and a man's voice, used as rhythm. Several adults whisper a count and one shouts three words before the drop.

INSTRUMENTS: Big, swelling, side-chained synth chords, broken garage-style drums with a crisp snare, a deep sub bass, bright bell-like plucks, a reversed cymbal, bare feet on tiles and a large splash.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, chords and chops. 0:20 Beat enters. 0:50 Section A. 1:30 Break, drums out. 1:44 Whispered count and the shout. 1:50 Drop, with the splash. 2:36 Outro, chords and water, ends 3:08.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2010s emotional UK electronic: wide, bright and clean, chords huge, drums tight and dry.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Last one in!' and the splash landing with the drop at 1:50.

STATION FIT: Sunday, 1:30 a.m. A rush of energy late in the night, with almost no words.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Giddy, daring, airborne, soaked.
